_comment: Example column mapping for data_loader.RealDataConfig when the source files use non-standard headers. For the Chinese second study (Paper 2), replace the keys with the actual column headers of the injury ledger and the inspection ledger.
notes: For the OSHA data used in this paper no mapping is needed: build_real_dataset.py and build_within_firm.py read the registry columns directly.
This file matters only for the reusable adapter data_loader.RealDataConfig, i.e. for a different source such as the Chinese records described in data/README_data.md.
